note: The poems' texts are not committed: each belongs to its writer. What is committed is where they were read, the hash of the bytes read, and per-poem line and syllable counts derived from them. A stranger re-fetches and compares.

forum.what: the 100 newest posts of the public forum r/haiku held by the PullPush archive on 2026-11-23 (posted 10 to 12 October 2026); the poem is the post's title split at '/', or a three-line body
forum.sheet: the first 50 posts, in the archive's order

journal.what: the web samples ('sample haiku & senryu') of Modern Haiku, issues 56.1 to 57.3 (2025 to 2026), 105 poems; author names not carried
journal.sheet: the first 50 poems, issues 57.3, 57.2, 57.1 and the first poems of 56.3

counter.licence: BSD-style, Carnegie Mellon University 1993-2015 (not committed; re-fetch)
counter.rule: syllables = vowel phonemes of the word's shortest pronunciation; words not in the dictionary by a vowel-group guess, flagged
